items.title: At long last, Mary Jane Veloso back home in Nueva Ecija
items.description: The moment that Mary Jane Veloso says she has fervently prayed for finally comes, following 16 long years of imprisonment

items.title: At Eurovision Asia, Carmelle steps onto her biggest stage yet
items.description: 'Gusto ko na makilala ako as someone na galing ng Pilipinas na magaling. Kahit papano, siguro mag-open din ‘yun ng door na mas makilala ‘yung ibang artist din na magagaling dito sa Pilipinas,' says Carmelle, the country's representative to Eurovision Asia

items.title: Record-breaking Albert Ian delos Santos earns Asian Games bronze
items.description: Filipino weightlifter Albert Ian delos Santos shatters his junior world and junior continental records on the way to an Asian Games bronze medal

items.title: TikTok reaches first state settlement in US over teen safety claims, agrees to user limits
items.description: Alabama secures $100 million settlement with TikTok, mandating new usage limits and age-verification measures to protect teens, as the state claims the platform endangers youth and misleads consumers about safety

items.title: Duterte camp flags 62,000-plus evidence ahead of ICC trial, seeks 10,000 cap
items.description: The defense team of former President Rodrigo Duterte has asked the International Criminal Court to limit the prosecution’s evidence to 10,000 items, saying the case record has ballooned to more than 62,000 items ahead of his trial.

items.title: Chris Gavina leaves UE, Paolo Hubalde takes over head coaching post
items.description: The coaching change comes as the UE Red Warriors battle through a 22-game losing streak dating back to October 2024

items.title: From Baguio to Sepang, Iñigo Anton gears up for biggest race of his career in F1 weekend
items.description: With a rookie title under his belt, Baguio’s Formula 4 driver Iñigo Anton heads to Sepang as the only Filipino on the grid, taking on the Malaysian circuit with an F1 crowd watching

items.title: ‘Queenie’ almost a typhoon
items.description: Severe Tropical Storm Queenie (international name: Surigae) is now nearing typhoon strength as it moves over the Philippine Sea, state weather bureau PAGASA said.

items.title: The week in photos: September 19-25, 2026
items.description: A recap of news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment, and human interest images from the Philippines and around the globe

items.title: Ilokano filmmaker spotlights real-life queer choir stories
items.description: A former choir member himself, Ilokano filmmaker Ryand Angelo Ugalde shares the dilemma of a trans man singer: should he continue hormone replacement therapy or preserve the voice that helps fund his studies?

items.title: OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges
items.description: OpenAI grapples with rogue agent incidents as privacy risks mount, revealing challenges in controlling AI behavior and prompting calls for industry caution.

items.title: It’s an ADMM-Plus joint sail, but where were the Southeast Asians?
items.description: In an Philippine and Japan-hosted and ASEAN-led joint sail, most Southeast Asian navies were absent. So was China.

items.title: P60 wage hike for Metro Manila minimum wage earners takes effect
items.description: Minimum wage earners in Metro Manila will get a P60 daily wage increase starting Saturday, September 26, under a new wage order issued by the Department of Labor and Employment.

items.title: Sara Duterte denies ex-Velasco aide’s claim he delivered over P2 billion to her
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte denied knowing Police Corporal Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. and receiving money from him, after the former security aide of ex-House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco alleged that he delivered more than P2 billion in cash to her.

items.title: ‘Queenie’ keeps strength, may become typhoon as it exits PAR Sunday
items.description: Severe Tropical Storm Queenie (international name: Surigae) maintained its strength as it decelerated while moving over the Philippine Sea, PAGASA said Saturday morning.

items.title: Leviste in France taking care of mom Loren
items.description: Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste is in France taking care of his mother, Sen. Loren Legarda, who is undergoing treatment for a lung and autoimmune condition.

items.title: China blocks Ayungin resupply mission anew
items.description: The military’s rotation and resupply (RORE) mission to the West Philippine Sea (WPS) did not reach its destination after 15 Chinese vessels shadowed it 60 nautical miles from Ayungin Shoal Thursday night.

items.title: SWS: 52 percent of Pinoys feel helpless vs corruption
items.description: A majority of Filipinos feel helpless about corruption in the government, a recent survey by the Social Weather Stations (SWS) showed.

items.title: DOTr lifts suspension of PUV fare hike
items.description: The approved fare hike for public utility vehicles will finally be implemented after the Department of Transportation (DOTr) yesterday lifted its earlier suspension.

items.title: Mark Villar to remain with minority – Cayetano
items.description: Sen. Mark Villar will remain with the minority bloc despite his recent vote to alter the conviction threshold denominator in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano said yesterday.
